test-ep-5.1.1-b-001: Verify that a Marketing Executive can fetch the field-level change log for a lead assigned to them. Response returns lead_history rows with DB columns: field_name, old_value, new_value, change_summary, changed_by, changed_at, reason. Default limit is 20, sorted newest-first by changed_at.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-002: Verify that the field_name query parameter filters results to only changes for the specified field.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-003: Verify pagination boundary — initial load returns at most 20 entries per page, with accurate pagination metadata.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-004: Verify second page retrieval returns remaining entries beyond the initial 20.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-005: Verify 403 Forbidden when a Marketing Executive queries field history for a lead assigned to a different user.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-006: Verify 404 when requesting field history for a non-existent lead UUID.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-007: Verify 400 when lead ID parameter is not a valid UUID format.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-008: Verify empty history response (lead with no lead_history rows) returns an empty array.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-009: Verify 401 when no authentication token is provided.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-010: Verify that Admin can view the full field-level change history for any lead in the system, bypassing ownership restrictions. Default limit is 50.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-011: Verify admin field history supports pagination with custom limit.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-012: Verify admin field history supports filtering by field_name.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-013: Verify 404 when admin requests field history for a non-existent lead.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-014: Verify 400 when admin uses an invalid lead ID format.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-015: Verify that a Marketing Executive cannot access the admin field-history endpoint (RBAC enforcement).
test-ep-5.1.1-b-016: Verify system-generated changes (auto stage validation, system rules) are returned with changed_by indicating system actor.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-017: Verify updating a lead’s stage creates a lead_history row capturing field_name, old_value, new_value, changed_by, changed_at — written in the same database transaction. The response includes a history_logged object confirming the entry.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-018: Verify that the history_logged object in the response exactly matches the corresponding lead_history row committed to the database.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-019: Verify 403 when a Marketing Executive attempts to update status on a lead not assigned to them.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-020: Verify 400 when status value is not in the allowed enum of valid stages.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-021: Verify 404 when updating status on a lead that does not exist.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-022: Verify 422 when an invalid stage transition is attempted (e.g., New -> Qualified directly, skipping Contacted). Response includes allowed_next array.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-023: Verify 401 when no authentication token is provided.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-024: Verify transaction atomicity — if the lead update fails after history row is inserted, both operations are rolled back. No orphan lead_history row exists.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-025: Verify that updating a tracked field with the same value does NOT create a duplicate lead_history entry.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-026: Verify Admin can assign an unassigned lead to a user. Creates a lead_history row with field_name = 'assigned_to' and an audit_logs entry.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-027: Verify reassigning a lead from one user to another creates a history entry showing both old and new assignee.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-028: Verify 400 when lead ID is not a valid UUID format.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-029: Verify 400 when assigned_to user ID is not a valid UUID format.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-030: Verify 404 when the lead does not exist.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-031: Verify 404 when the target user does not exist in the users table.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-032: Verify 403 when a Marketing Executive attempts to access the admin assign endpoint.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-033: Verify transaction atomicity — if the lead update succeeds but the lead_history insert fails, the entire operation rolls back and leads.assigned_to remains unchanged.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-034: Close a lead as Won — creates lead_history row for stage field, records final_deal_value and closure_date on the lead.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-035: Close a lead as Lost — creates lead_history row and records loss_reason on the lead.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-036: Verify 403 when attempting to close a lead not assigned to the user.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-037: Verify 404 when closing a non-existent lead.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-038: Verify 400 when close status is not Won or Lost.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-039: Verify 400 when closing as Lost without providing loss_reason.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-040: Verify 400 when loss_reason is not in the allowed enum values.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-041: Verify 400 when closing as Won without final_deal_value and closure_date.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-043: Verify transaction atomicity — if the lead update succeeds but lead_history insert fails, the entire close operation rolls back.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-044: Admin reopens a Won lead — creates lead_history row recording the transition from Won to Contacted with the reopen reason.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-045: Admin reopens a Lost lead — same behavior as reopening a Won lead.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-046: Verify 400 when reopen reason is missing.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-047: Verify 400 when reopening a lead that is not in Won or Lost status.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-048: Verify 404 when reopening a non-existent lead.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-049: Verify 403 when a Marketing Executive attempts to reopen a lead.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-050: Verify transaction atomicity — both the lead record update and lead_history insertion occur in the same transaction.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-051: Admin exports a lead’s field history as CSV. The CSV content matches exactly what is shown on screen, with columns: field_name, old_value, new_value, change_summary, changed_by, changed_at, reason.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-052: Verify 400 when the format parameter is not csv.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-053: Verify 404 when exporting history for a non-existent lead.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-054: Verify 404 when the lead has no lead_history rows to export.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-055: Verify 403 when a Marketing Executive attempts to export field history.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-056: Admin fetches the system-wide audit log with filters (actor, action_type, entity_affected, date range). Response uses audit_logs DB columns: action_type, actor, entity_affected, entity_id, result, ip_address, details, created_at.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-057: Verify audit log pagination with configurable page size.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-058: Verify filtering by entity_affected returns only entries for that entity type.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-059: Verify 400 when from or to date parameters are not in valid YYYY-MM-DD format.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-060: Verify empty response when no audit log entries match the applied filters.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-061: Verify 403 when a Marketing Executive attempts to access the audit log.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-062: Verify SQL injection attempt on filter parameters is properly sanitized.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-063: Admin fetches a single audit log entry by its UUID with full detail.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-064: Verify 404 when the audit log entry does not exist.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-065: Verify 400 when the audit log ID is not a valid UUID format.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-066: Verify 403 when a Marketing Executive attempts to view a single audit log entry.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-067: Admin exports the audit log as CSV within a specified date range.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-068: Verify 400 when export format is not csv.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-069: Verify 400 when date format in from or to is invalid.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-070: Verify 403 when a Marketing Executive attempts to export the audit log.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-071: Verify that PUT requests against the lead_history resource are rejected (HTTP 405), ensuring the history table is insert-only.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-072: Verify that PATCH requests against the lead_history resource are rejected (HTTP 405).
test-ep-5.1.1-b-073: Verify that DELETE requests against the lead_history resource are rejected (HTTP 405).
test-ep-5.1.1-b-074: Verify that no POST route exists to manually insert lead_history rows — history is only created internally by tracking middleware.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-075: Verify XSS prevention — script tags stored in old_value or new_value are returned safely in JSON without server-side processing or execution.
test-ep-5.1.1-b-076: Verify query performance on lead_history with large datasets (10,000+ entries for a single lead).
